name: Weather
reason: Folks, it's a mild-to-warm, nearly bone-dry week with calm conditions building, so the setup leans favorable for a bloom, but with highs averaging only 25.8C and just 2 hot days we're not yet in full-blown bloom heat.
evidence: Average max temp 25.8C, warm but below the 30C bloom-boosting threshold
Only 0.8 mm of rain all week, so no flushing or mixing from storms
2 hot days, enough to warm surface water but not a sustained heat run
Early June timing means the water may still be warming up
